title: EZiL models config
description: Model providers and models served to the Copilot Chat UI by the EZiL Models extension. String values may reference secrets as {env:NAME} or {file:/path}.

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

providers.description: Named provider endpoints. A model refers to one by name.

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

defaults.description: Defaults merged into every model entry (a model's own keys win).

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

type.markdownDescription:
- `anthropic`: api.anthropic.com Messages API (`x-api-key`).
- `anthropic-foundry`: Claude on Microsoft Foundry, `https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic/v1/messages` (`x-api-key`).
- `openai`: api.openai.com chat completions (Bearer).
- `azure-openai`: `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/chat/completions` or a Foundry `openai/v1` baseUrl (`api-key`).
- `openai-compatible`: any `<baseUrl>/chat/completions` server (Bearer if a key is set).
- `ezil-gateway`: EZiL Worker proxy `/ai/v1/messages` (Bearer). No custom headers or beta flags are forwarded.

baseUrl.description: Overrides the endpoint base. anthropic: default https://api.anthropic.com. anthropic-foundry: ...services.ai.azure.com/anthropic. openai: https://api.openai.com/v1. azure-openai: https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1. openai-compatible: required.

resource.description: Azure resource name for anthropic-foundry / azure-openai (used when baseUrl is not set).

apiVersion.description: azure-openai only: appended as ?api-version=. Not needed for the openai/v1 surface.

headers.description: Extra request headers (values may be secret references).

betas.description: Anthropic beta feature ids sent in anthropic-beta.

maxTokensField.description: OpenAI-style providers: which field carries the output limit (default max_completion_tokens; openai-compatible defaults to max_tokens).

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

type.description: adaptive for Claude 4.6+ (Opus 5/5.5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5.1); enabled + budgetTokens for Haiku 4.5 and older; disabled sends {type: disabled} (rejected by Opus 5.5 / Fable 5.1).

effort.description: Anthropic output_config.effort; mapped to reasoning_effort for OpenAI/Azure (xhigh and max become high).

display.description: Anthropic thinking.display for adaptive thinking. "updates" (Fable 5.x / Opus 5.5 progress notes) adds the thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18 beta header.

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

enabled.description: Anthropic prompt caching (default true for anthropic providers, ignored elsewhere).

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

toolCalling.description: true, false, or the maximum number of tools.

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

maxInputTokens.description: Gateway raw input cap (default 131072). Advertised allowance subtracts 1056 framing, 1536 envelope, and toolReserve.

maxOutputTokens.description: Gateway default: Qwen 8192, Kimi 4096; clamped to 16..16384.

forcedToolChoice.description: Always false for ezil-gateway; Required maps to auto.

stream.description: Use Anthropic SSE. Kimi K3 always uses JSON, even if true.

toolReserve.description: Gateway input allowance reserved for tool schemas, which Copilot does not count.

$comment.description: Free-form note; ignored by the extension.

id.description: Stable id shown to VS Code; use it in chat.defaultModel. Unique, case-insensitive.

name.description: Display name in the model picker (defaults to id).

model.description: Provider model id (claude-opus-5-5, gpt-5.5...) or the Azure deployment name.

family.description: VS Code model family (defaults to claude or gpt). chat.defaultModel also matches on family.

maxInputTokens.description: Gateway raw input cap (default 131072). Advertised allowance subtracts 1056 framing, 1536 envelope, and toolReserve.

maxOutputTokens.description: Gateway default: Qwen 8192, Kimi 4096; clamped to 16..16384.

default.description: Exactly one model may be the default (also implied by roles containing default).

roles.description: Which Copilot Chat slots this model should fill; used by 'EZiL Models: Manage -> Copy settings snippet'.

forcedToolChoice.description: Always false for ezil-gateway; Required maps to auto.

stream.description: Use Anthropic SSE. Kimi K3 always uses JSON, even if true.

toolReserve.description: Gateway input allowance reserved for tool schemas, which Copilot does not count.
